proposal.reason: Primary change is in NET transport/proxy behavior: send-credit heads are now defaulted to sender-local device memory with new mapping/open/close lifecycle, connection wiring, and initialization in `src/transport/net.cc`. `transport` is additionally required because P2P transport gained a new allocation-only proxy buffer setup/free path and connection ownership flag (`pcclP2pAllocateProxyBuffer`, `p2pBufferAlloc`) that NET depends on but is substantive transport resource-management logic. `memory` is additionally required because shared allocation semantics were extended with `MEM_LEGACY` and corresponding alloc/free + tracking behavior in `src/include/alloc.h`, changing core memory-management mode handling beyond a mechanical caller edit.
